training_data.name: medical-o1-reasoning-SFT
training_data.quote: This dataset is constructed using GPT-4o, which searches for solutions to verifiable medical problems and validates them through a medical verifier. The Hub viewer shows the en subset at 19.7k rows, en_mix 24.9k, zh 20.2k, and zh_mix 25.4k. Columns: Question, Complex_CoT, Response. The model card's example question is the first English row.

description.text:
A medical reasoning model fine-tuned on Ministral-3-8B-Reasoning-2512 for clinical question answering and diagnostic reasoning.

This model is a specialized medical AI assistant trained in two phases:
- Phase 1: Medical knowledge foundation (Q&A, clinical conversations)
- Phase 2: Clinical reasoning and diagnostic thinking

The model demonstrates strong reasoning capabilities for medical scenarios, particularly in differential diagnosis and clinical decision-making.

serving.text_only_input_quote: print(chat("Given the symptoms of sudden weakness in the left arm and leg, recent long-distance travel, and the presence of swollen and tender right lower leg, what specific cardiac abnormality is most likely to be found upon further evaluation that could explain these findings?"))
serving.system_prompt:
# HOW YOU SHOULD THINK AND ANSWER

First draft your thinking process (inner monologue) until you arrive at a response. Format your response using Markdown, and use LaTeX for any mathematical equations. Write both your thoughts and the response in the same language as the input.

Your thinking process must follow the template below:[THINK]Your thoughts or/and draft, like working through an exercise on scratch paper. Be as casual and as long as you want until you are confident to generate the response to the user.[/THINK]Here, provide a self-contained response.
serving.notes: The card says the training context length was 2048 tokens. config.json text_config.max_position_embeddings is 262144, and generation_config.json max_length is 262144. The architecture is Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration with a Pixtral vision_config and image_token_index 10, so the checkpoint can take an image. The card's only example is a text question. Sampling values are from that example; generation_config.json does not set temperature or top_p. The default system prompt above is the template's default_system_message when no system message is passed. No adapter_config.json. The file list includes a commit message "Upload merged model in fp16 precision (Trained with Unsloth)" and the API reports 8,918,026,240 F16 parameters, so the LoRA was merged. config.json has unsloth_version 2025.12.4. 4-bit inference is mentioned only for evaluation, not for training. https://github.com/Naazimsnh02/medical-ministral-8b has no README body. Ministral 3 (arXiv:2601.08584) does not name this repository. HuatuoGPT-o1 (arXiv:2412.18925) is linked from the medical-o1 dataset card; its full text was not read.

evaluation_reported.text: MMLU-Pro, partial evaluation. Full precision: Biology & Health, 270 samples, 68.9%. 4-bit: Biology 390 samples 68.7%; Health 390 samples 56.1%.
